column2: # 中文：把分组变量换成 property_type，为各物业类别分别估计评分密度；通常比 room_type 有更多类别。
# English: Replace the grouping variable with property_type to estimate a rating density for each property category, usually many more groups than room_type.
# 中文：drop_na() 排除评分缺失，但不能解决组内有效观测太少的问题；密度估计通常至少需要两个观测。
# English: drop_na() removes missing ratings but cannot fix very small groups; density estimation normally requires at least two observations.
# 中文：若提示少于两个观测的组被丢弃，应检查组样本量；过多颜色和重叠也会影响可读性。
# English: If groups with fewer than two observations are dropped, inspect their sample sizes; many colours and overlaps also reduce readability.
# 中文：本块原标签 Count 仍应理解为 Density；将来的类别合并必须有实质理由，不能只为了使图更好看。
# English: Interpret the original Count label as Density here as well; any later category collapsing should have substantive justification, not only improve appearance.
